title: Publish calendar, scheduling và native/manual proof
scope_items: Database Migration 00026: Created publish_items, publish_jobs, publish_logs, and channel_posts tables with workspace composite tenant keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), foreign keys to workspaces and connected_accounts, and narrow role-based grants (publish_logs is strictly append-only SELECT/INSERT for app_user); reversible transactional down migration verified.

Acceptance Target 1 (Never publish before schedule): Schedule fairness jitter delay (0..30s) is strictly non-negative and additive (effective_time >= schedule_at). Dispatch timing watchdog rejects execution when now < schedule_at with ErrPrematurePublish / PrematurePublishError.

Acceptance Target 2 (Unknown submit reconciles): Platform timeouts, connection drops, and unknown submit results are recorded as unknown; the system never blindly re-posts or assumes success. Reconciles via provider request ID status check (marking published if confirmed on remote platform, or retry_pending without duplicate posting).

Acceptance Target 3 (Manual proof retains graph): Manual fallback export packages generate download URLs, formatted captions, hashtags, platform checklists, and verification URLs. Operator proof submissions create immutable publish_logs records (execution_path='manual_upload', result_status='success', evidence_ref) and update publish_items to published while retaining the full graph connection.

Acceptance Target 4 (Token revoke pauses affected queued work): Credential revocation (auth_revoked) during execution immediately fails the executing job with auth_expired, and pauses (diagnostics_state='blocked') all other queued/scheduled jobs targeting that same connected account without auto-failing them or affecting other accounts.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_NeverPublishBeforeSchedule and TestAcceptanceTarget1_ScheduleFairnessJitterActivation (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter tests confirm non-negative additive jitter and rejection of premature execution.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_UnknownSubmitReconciles (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter tests confirm remote status reconciliation via provider request ID without duplicate dispatch.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_ManualProofRetainsGraph (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter tests confirm manual export package generation, immutable audit log creation, and graph retention to publish items/jobs.

Acceptance Target 4 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget4_TokenRevokePausesAffectedQueuedWork (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter tests confirm account isolation, executing job failure, and targeted pausing of queued jobs sharing the revoked account.
Migration 00026 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 26 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, and Dart test suites.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: Vitest web test suite (27 files, 213 tests passing), svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), Vite production build (adapter-node ✔ done), and Flutter test suite (182 tests passing, flutter analyze 0 issues) all pass.
external_gates: Direct native TikTok video publishing requires approved TikTok Developer App with video.publish and video.upload scopes; manual fallback package and proof flow verified locally.
Meta / Instagram Reels publishing requires approved Instagram Content Publishing API permissions; manual proof flow verified locally.

Migration 00026 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow grants verified via dry-run and local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.
